baseline.notes: The designated AwesomeSalesforceSkills-main (3).zip archive was mounted and hashed. Its SHA-256 matches the earlier inspectable (1).zip fallback byte-for-byte, so reconciliation used commit 7e0ecaba888f3d986362782f04d7035064bfce34 created from the (3) extract as the exact latest baseline. Upstream candidate archives remain unavailable for byte-level pins.

pin.reason: The user-supplied archive was not mounted, so no archive hash, commit, or tag is asserted for the reviewed snapshot.

sources.content_use: Topic and product-function discovery only. The accepted decision and learning workflows were independently authored.

decisions.scope: Create a traceable Salesforce decision-analysis workflow and runtime surface.
decisions.rationale: The fallback corpus had ADR recording and narrow decision trees but no reusable pre-commitment decision packet with hard gates, evidence states, sensitivity, and reversibility.
decisions.routing: Use /decide-salesforce for one consequential decision; route narrow technology choices to existing decision trees and accepted decisions to architecture-decision-records.

decisions.scope: Separate citation-first research from learner-facing synthesis and expose both through one runtime guide.
decisions.rationale: A two-stage evidence and teaching contract prevents stale or unsupported claims from being converted directly into instructional prose while retaining a simple user command.
decisions.routing: Use /learn-salesforce for the end-to-end flow; use architect/salesforce-learning-research for evidence packets and admin/salesforce-learning-brief for synthesis from verified evidence.

validation.command: new skill checker passing and failing fixtures

attestation.clean_room: Although MIT was reported, no source archive bytes were available. Only the two product functions were used as discovery signals; all wording, scripts, templates, and tests were authored independently.
attestation.product_boundary: All accepted additions remain read-only analysis, teaching, retrieval, or local validation guidance. They do not deploy, mutate an org, grant authority, or bypass the V2.0/V2.1/V2.2 product gates.
